title: Power of Two
statement: Return whether n is a power of two, that is whether n equals 2 raised to some non-negative integer power. Zero and negative numbers are not.
hints: Dividing by two while the number stays even works. Then ask what a power of two looks like written in binary.
Exactly one bit set. So the question becomes: does n have exactly one bit set?

n & (n - 1) clears the lowest set bit. If the result is zero there was only one bit, so the test is n > 0 && (n & (n - 1)) == 0. The n > 0 guard is not optional: without it, int.MinValue and 0 both slip through.

cases.name: int.MinValue: one bit set but negative
